acceptedIntermediateCases.behavior: User completes Bilibili homepage QR login. Static-host GM checks include target session cookies and identify signed-in. Official website marks the current folder private (38 entries); GM loads 28 mapped first-page tracks, then 36 mapped tracks over two pages. Private IDs/titles are redacted.

Precision DOM cancellation retains 28 existing tracks and ignores a completed late second-page response. Explicit continuation loads the second page to 36 tracks. No wire abort was observed, so this case does not claim ERR_ABORTED.

Fresh GM private-folder read on the Bilibili source host returns 28 tracks; one explicit playurl resolution starts native .m4s audio and advances to 24.03 seconds before an explicit pause. This is private-folder access, not a claim of paid/private-video entitlement.

Static-host GM session/search succeeds with included target cookies. Signing-only bridge produces signatures without a duplicate API request. One result returns AM-2002; another exposes the missing media permission and succeeds after repair.

Intermediate repaired production artifact reaches playing Range/MSE audio; Studio→classic→Studio retains the identical audio/currentSrc, with time 13.08→41.55→62.16 seconds. Hide/show retains it at 76.33→86.84 seconds. No extra detail resolve across presentation changes.

On the Douyin source host, signature-triggered precision DOM cancellation stops a new search before GM dispatch; its signing wait cancels after the bounded 5s interval. Explicit retry sends one GM search, which returns the upstream verification-required state AM-3005. The corresponding official search page requires a user-completed CAPTCHA; no success is inferred from website requests. A later official search-page visit presents no CAPTCHA; the installed source is re-hashed as 2cd84173…ee080, its page SDK returns a signature and one explicit real-GM retry returns 10 tracks. This does not assert a new user CAPTCHA completion that was not observed.

Signed-out NetEase GM session is explicit. Song 33894312 imports through GM and resolves once to native CDN playback; initial artifact survives both theme directions (9.64→22.37→54.56 seconds). Repaired intermediate source-host playback advances to 39.89 seconds.

Precision DOM cancellation stops search before dispatch. Blocking the real GM search produces AM-4001; removing the fault does not replay it. Explicit retry sends a new GM request and reveals the artist-zero schema error, now fixed with deterministic tests. Final installed c944e1c9…907134 returns 30 tracks for that query on both static and source hosts; explicit continuation reaches 60 retained tracks/two pages with no AM-3003.

Matching source-host option order is Bilibili/Douyin/NetEase first respectively; saved source selection remains respected. One product audio/root is observed, host receives no product CSS, and three same-origin NetEase iframes contain no product root. Two-source disable stops active NetEase playback; restoration does not auto-play, and the core favorites view remains usable. Settings protect the last enabled source, so no zero-source pass is claimed.
